svg.title: Ehyeh asher Ehyeh: I AM WHO I AM
svg.desc: Ehyeh asher Ehyeh, אֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה: I AM WHO I AM. “But I will be with you” … God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM.” (Exodus 3:12, 14 (ESV)). In the scene: Horeb, the mountain of God, and the flock (Exodus 3:1); the bush burning, yet not consumed (3:2); sandals off on holy ground (3:5).
